subject: Request to lock exec slot and finalize pilot calendar
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@retailforge.com>, j.dunn@retailforge.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to lock exec slot and finalize pilot calendar

Hi Samira — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock the pilot runway: 

- Key takeaways from discovery: RetailForge will pilot Redwood for product search reranking and dynamic personalization on a 2-week sample of transactions.
- Success metrics: 8–12% CTR lift on recommendations, <50ms median inference latency for catalog queries at typical load.
- External requirements you called out: SOC2 evidence, data retention policy, and an on-prem ingestion option for PII-sensitive fields.

Next steps we recommended on the call:
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO handshake) to confirm timeline and signoff on pilot gating criteria — 30 minutes
2) Technical deep dive / demo (engineering + infra) to validate integration plan — 60 minutes
3) Deliverables: POC runbook + access plan by Redwood; sample dataset ingestion instructions from RetailForge.

Can you confirm who from your executive team should join the 30-minute VP/CTO alignment? If possible, please include the CTO or a VP who can greenlight the pilot window. Below are specific windows (PT) that work on our side for a 30-minute exec touch:

- Tue 10 Mar, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Tue 10 Mar, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Wed 11 Mar, 11:00–11:30 PT

I’ve attached the draft POC checklist and pre-demo requirements for reference. If none of the slots work, flag three alternatives and we’ll triangulate.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 82 KB)]
- [Attachment: pre-demo-reqs.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0118

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@retailforge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Dunn <michael.dunn@retailforge.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request to lock exec slot and finalize pilot calendar

Thanks for the concise recap, Irene — that matches our notes. I’m looping in our CTO, Michael Dunn, who needs to be on the exec alignment call.

Michael — quick background: Redwood captured the use case well. We want a 30-minute alignment to confirm the runway and gating criteria before legal/procurement start the SOW.

Our availabilities (ET):
- Mon 9 Mar, 13:30–14:00 ET
- Tue 10 Mar, 12:00–12:30 ET
- Wed 11 Mar, 16:00–16:30 ET

If any of those work for you and the Redwood execs, we’ll lock it. Also, we’ll review the POC checklist internally and send any clarifying questions by EOD Friday.

Samira Khan
Head of Product Operations
RetailForge

Quick technical note from my side — happy to join the exec call for a brief alignment if useful, and lead the technical deep dive afterwards. From an engineering availability perspective we can do a 30-min VP/CTO sync on either of these (PT):

- Mon 9 Mar, 10:30–11:00 PT (matches Samira's Mon 13:30 ET)
- Tue 10 Mar, 09:00–09:30 PT (matches Samira's Tue 12:00 ET)

For the subsequent technical deep dive (60 min), suggested slots (PT): Wed 11 Mar, 09:00–10:00 PT or Thu 12 Mar, 13:00–14:00 PT.

I’ve created a tentative calendar proposal — please accept or suggest alternatives: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-proposed-slot

Also noting: we will need the dataset schema and a sample of anonymized records two business days before the technical deep dive so the team can validate performance on representative traffic.

— Aditya
